meta.description: Exercises the osv CEL plugin end-to-end over an OSV predicate produced by the internal:vulnreport transformer (Trivy -> OSV).

tenets.code: size(predicates) == 1 && size(osv.vulns(predicates[0])) == 2 && 'CVE-2025-21613' in osv.ids(predicates[0]) && osv.vulns(predicates[0]).exists(v, osv.matchesID(v, 'CVE-2025-21613') && osv.cvss(v) >= 9.0 && osv.isFixed(v)) && osv.forEcosystem(predicates[0], 'Go').all(v, osv.isFixed(v))

assessment.message: osv plugin resolved the OSV predicate: found CVE-2025-21613 as a fixed CRITICAL (CVSS >= 9.0) and every Go vulnerability is fixed

error.message: osv plugin checks did not match expectations
error.guidance: The internal:vulnreport transformer should emit an OSV predicate over which the osv plugin (osv.vulns/osv.ids/osv.matchesID/osv.cvss/osv.isFixed/osv.forEcosystem) resolves CVE-2025-21613 as a fixed CRITICAL vulnerability
